articles.t: GTA 6 leaker says the missing Xbox file is now out
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek says it has released the missing executable for an alleged GTA 6 leak of 209GB. Rockstar hasn't commented, and the files are unverified.
articles.txt:
The group behind the alleged GTA 6 Xbox build claims it could run on PC through emulation within a week, but the files haven’t been independently verified.
0:00 A self-described hacker group says it released the main executable for an alleged GTA 6 Xbox build, but the files haven’t been independently verified.
GTA 6 launched on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 November, and Rockstar hasn’t announced a PC version. The group, Cyberleek, claims the community could get the game running on PC through emulation within a week at more than 30fps. No independently verified PC build has demonstrated that.
VideoCardz reported on launch day that Cyberleek had distributed roughly 209GB of files via BitTorrent. The group had already circulated pre-launch gameplay footage and promised a playable build if its meme coin reached a $30 million market cap. The coin never reached that target, and the promised build didn’t arrive.
Cyberleek described the files as a near-complete Xbox build from November 2026, but initially held back the main executable. The group said it would release that file when a countdown expired on 23 November, or sooner if its CYBERLEEK token reached a $15 million market cap. On Monday, 23 November, Cyberleek said it had released the executable, about three hours before the countdown was due to end.
In coverage of the alleged build , Cyberleek described the release as “an early Christmas gift”. The group denied accusations of a pump-and-dump scheme and used a note accompanying the executable to criticise digital-only releases, extra charges for content, and the sale of licences as purchases.
Found us on Google? Add tbreak as a preferred source to see more of our stories in Top Stories.
Xbox Series X|S consoles and modern Windows PCs share the same processor architecture, but Windows can’t simply open an Xbox game. An unofficial port would still need to account for console-specific system functions and graphics.
The cybersecurity account VX Underground says it found GTA 6 assets in the files and believes the build is genuine. Notebookcheck reports that independent projects Leonida, Xbox2Windows, and AnyXboxX are investigating whether the files could support an unofficial PC version.
An X user named Chasm posted footage that appeared to show a Windows desktop opening the game’s settings menu, with audio but no in-game graphics. The clip hasn’t been independently verified and doesn’t demonstrate playable performance.
Neither Rockstar Games nor its parent, Take-Two Interactive, has publicly commented on the latest claim. Take-Two previously described its investigation into the leaker as “rapidly evolving” and filed subpoenas seeking information from Discord about specific servers and users.
Netcraft has identified fake Cyberleek sites distributing malware or asking for cryptocurrency payments, so downloads carry risk.

articles.t: The first 'GTA 6' patch is live: 7 fixes address fan complaints
articles.chapeau: Nothing monumental, but every little bit helps.
articles.txt:
By now, anyone reading this has probably gotten themselves a PS5 or Xbox and played at least a handful of hours of Grand Theft Auto VI after it launched last week. Next time you go to play the game on your console of choice, there will likely be a patch you have to download.
On Monday, Rockstar released the first official post-launch update for GTA 6 . It's not a hugely seismic patch by any means, as it largely addresses a handful of in-game glitches that range from minor to major. Since GTA 6 is not a multiplayer game, you might be able to play it without downloading the patch, but based on the patch notes, you will probably want to wait for it to install first.
According to Rockstar's update notes, the first GTA 6 patch is intended to fix seven common bugs players had encountered in the first few days after launch. Here are all the things Rockstar said it fixed on Monday:
An issue that caused weather to not change for extended periods of time
"Several issues" that caused in-game phone calls, including ones that push the story forward, to not trigger on time
An issue that caused partner characters to not hand bags of contraband to the player
As you can see, these range from minor irritations to nearly game-breaking glitches. Phone calls not triggering properly is especially bad, as they regularly unlock new story missions. Obviously, not being able to lose a wanted level would also be a pretty big bummer.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' players love its in-game memes
articles.chapeau: The images aim to capture the irreverent, off-colour vibe of real internet memes.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) offers a satirical rendition of the U.S., filled with cars, crime, and shenanigans worthy of the game's Florida-inspired setting. It also incorporates many digital elements of modern life, including social media. Of course, where there's social media, there are inevitably memes.
In-game social media app Snapmatic is GTA 6 's version of Instagram , offering a scrollable feed of posts from fictional characters showing off their very lootable possessions. However, Snapmatic isn't just filled with posts sharing potential theft coordinates . It also contains a plethora of memes specifically created to populate GTA 6 's social media.
Players quickly took note of GTA 6 's memes, praising them for accurately capturing the irreverent vibe and frequently off-colour humour that typically characterises such media.
" GTA 6 is so realistic that I thought this was a real meme," posted X user @thisdopenose, sharing an image of an in-game meme. In the meme, the text "bisexuals when they realise you can have sex more than twice" is edited onto a monochrome image of a man crying. The popular post has 94,000 likes at time of writing.
"They need to give a pay rise to whoever came up with the shitposts on Snapmatic bro these things are so funny," wrote @vandalfeet.
Some of GTA 6 's in-game memes even referred to memes about GTA 6 itself. It's been 13 years since GTA 5 launched, with many fans having eagerly awaited the franchises' latest instalment for over a decade. In the interim, it became a common meme for people to jokingly express disbelief that various other events had occurred "before GTA 6 " arrived.
Developer Rockstar Games appears to have been aware of such memes, creating its own versions referring to GTA 6 's fictional video game Race and Chase 7 . ( "Race'n'Chase" was the original working title for the first Grand Theft Auto game released in 1997).
Rockstar Games had teams dedicated to creating in-game media , aiming to flesh out GTA 6 's world and make it feel more immersive. Judging by fans' reactions, it appears to have paid off. Parent company Take-Two Interactive estimates that GTA 6 achieved $3.79 billion in sales on day one alone, making it one of the biggest entertainment media launches ever. articles.t: PlayStation Portal can cloud stream GTA 6 without PS5 console, but Sony blocks PCs
articles.chapeau: PlayStation Portal supporters can experience GTA 6 even without a PS5 console. Sony introduced cloud streaming for the Rockstar game through PS Plus Premium subscriptions. Other devices, including PCs, could access the streaming feature before Sony discontinued its Windows app.
articles.txt:
Another reasonably affordable way to play GTA 6 has arrived soon after its release date . Sony has made the Rockstar title cloud streaming compatible on the PlayStation Portal . PS Plus Premium subscribers don’t need to own a pricey PS5 console . Unfortunately, the recent shutdown of a Windows app has blocked access on PCs .
Social media posters noticed the company added a new tag to the PlayStation Store page . To play the GTA 6 PS5 version on the gaming handheld, Premium tier members must still purchase the game. However, they can do so through the marketplace’s mobile app or website.
Previously, PlayStation Portal loyalists more commonly used Remote Play . This method relies on having a PS5 console at home. Starting in 2024, Sony launched cloud streaming for select games in the PS Plus Premium library. Notably, this differs from the streaming feature on other tiers, which doesn’t require digital licenses for titles.
Ahead of the GTA 6 release date, a Verge report claimed Xbox would hold exclusive cloud streaming rights. That turned out to be false, but it is available on the Xbox Series X|S and even the aging Xbox One. It’s unclear when Microsoft or its rival may expand access to a wider range of devices.
Until recently, PCs, the Steam Deck , and various gaming handhelds could connect to Sony’s cloud servers. Sadly, the company discontinued its Windows app, and third-party alternatives are no longer options either. Asobi mimicked PlayStation Portal functionality and offered ports on multiple platforms. Its developer is currently searching for a workaround.
Some gamers are now pinning their hopes on an unofficial GTA 6 PC port . Cyberleek leaked an Xbox build that several groups are adapting for Windows. Whether they can solve compatibility issues before Take-Two or Rockstar lawyers file DMCA notices is questionable.
For now, PlayStation Portal owners benefit the most from the new cloud streaming option. Boosted by a growing PS Plus Premium catalog, the $249.99 system has become less dependent on $600+ PS5 consoles.

articles.t: GTA 6's Best Easter Egg Is a Classic Tom Cruise Crime-Thriller You Can Stream For Free
articles.chapeau: A random NPC encounter in GTA 6 sounds an awful lot like Tom Cruise, and you can stream the thriller that inspired the encounter for free
articles.txt:
One of Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s strangest random encounters occurs when you’re offering taxi services, and a man with a beard wearing a dark suit and sunglasses climbs into the backseat with a gun. This can happen if you’re playing as either Jason or Lucia, but both scenes play out the same way: The man wants you to run a red light, ignore phone calls, and drive him to Harborside Park in Vice Beach. He also sounds an awful lot like Tom Cruise, with a calm but forceful demeanor that seems almost sociopathic . Several clips of the sequence have already hit the internet, and to many people, it’s an obvious nod to Collateral , Michael Mann’s 2004 thriller about a hitman who takes a cab driver hostage.
Jason or Lucia gets a better deal than Mann’s cabbie in this Easter egg . If you take the stranger to his destination and follow him inside after he takes out some of the criminals there, you can find a ton of valuable loot. Most players seem keen on eliminating the stranger rather than keep driving him around . In Collateral , Jamie Foxx’s character, Max, has to spend the whole night driving Cruise’s Vincent around Los Angeles. If you’ve never seen how that goes for him, Collateral is streaming for free on Pluto TV — and it’s a must-watch, especially if you want a movie that has a vibe as wild and crime-filled as GTA 6 ’s .
Max is a cab driver who’s been telling himself for years that the job is temporary. He wants to start his own limo company someday, so when a well-dressed passenger named Vincent (Cruise) offers him $600 to drive him around for the night, it seems like the kind of opportunity that could get him a little closer to quitting. Then a body lands on his cab at their first destination. Vincent has five people to kill before the night is over. Max has just agreed to drive him to all five stops — and he’s already an accomplice.

The same certainty that lets Ethan Hunt talk somebody into jumping out of a plane makes it seem perfectly reasonable, for about half a second, when Vincent asks Max to help him stuff a body in the trunk. He’s also an obnoxious backseat driver. The longer he spends in the cab, the more interested he becomes in why Max has seemingly wasted so much of his life. Some of his advice is irritatingly solid, yet he’s also a man who could end the conversation with a single gunshot whenever he wanted to.
Despite the plot focusing entirely on Vincent’s assassinations, Foxx emerges as the real heart of Collateral . Early on, he picks up a prosecutor named Annie (Jada Pinkett Smith), and their conversation has the easy rhythm of two strangers who realize they’d like the ride to last a little longer. You get to see how good Max is at putting people at ease as he flirts a little. Then, Vincent hops in the back, and the nightmare begins. Once the hitman is in the car, even the smallest decisions Max makes​​​​​​​ — like when to look in the rear-view mirror and when to keep his eyes on the road — feel like consequential choices Max must make carefully​​​​​​​ .
For a movie about a man on a deadline, Collateral is remarkably willing to pull over and look around. Vincent himself comments early on about how much​​​​​​​ he despises the city’s sprawling, depersonalized atmosphere. Mann often dwells on that atmosphere​​​​​​​ to build up tension. In the movie's best quiet moment, a coyote crosses the road in front of the cab, and both men stop talking to watch it. Los Angeles feels eerie and sinister, lit by flickering streetlights and bland storefronts. As their night continues, even mundane locations feel like the most dangerous places in Los Angeles.
Image: DreamWorks / Courtesy Everett Collection The story’s arc is also immensely satisfying. articles.t: GTA 6 Online release update: What we know so far
articles.chapeau: Here are the latest details.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI was released on consoles last week, with millions of players exploring Leonida on Xbox and PS5 consoles. But one major question remains: What's happening with the online mode?
The GTA Online component of Grand Theft Auto V has kept that 13-year-old game relevant across three console generations, with a recent leak suggesting Rockstar makes as much as $500 million annually from microtransactions alone. One would think that means GTA VI will have a similar online offering available at launch, but that isn't the case. Per a Rockstar statement given to IGN , as well as all available marketing language on digital storefronts, GTA VI is a "single-player experience."
There was no online component at launch, nor has Rockstar announced any intention of adding one after launch. Sadly, that is all the concrete information anyone can provide right now.
However, that doesn't mean all hope is lost. It's worth remembering that both GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 launched as solo experiences and got online modes later, though it was only a matter of months in both cases. Given that Rockstar hasn't even said if there will be a new GTA Online experience for VI , it's probably safe to assume the wait will be longer this time.
The fact that the existing GTA Online is so wildly successful (with no signs of slowing down) means Rockstar isn't necessarily incentivized to make a new one right away. It also means Rockstar has to decide if it wants to keep two different GTA Online experiences running at the same time, should GTA VI ever get one. As IGN noted, Grand Theft Auto publisher Take-Two currently supports two different NBA 2K Online games in the Asian market; the first launched in 2012 and its sequel in 2017, but they're both popular enough to coexist to this day.
Unfortunately, we don't have a definitive answer on when we'll get a new GTA Online mode tied to the new game, but hey, single-player games aren't so bad. I'm sure there will be plenty of hours of entertainment to be had in GTA VI as it is.

There are some standout elements, like the mission that transitions players from Chapter 1 to Chapter 2 , which features exceptional storytelling and is a blast to play through. However, as much as I'm enjoying my time with GTA 6 , like many others, I find some changes confounding.
The game had a lot of expectations to live up to, and it ultimately succeeded as an action-adventure game with some RPG-like elements. But that's also where it may have gone too far in some respects, leaning into what worked for Red Dead Redemption 2 . While RDR2 is a masterpiece in its own right, it works at a slower pace, as the Western genre often does. GTA is a fast-paced mayhem simulator.
GTA 6 is still a massive open world where your actions have consequences that affect everything around you. But the rampage-style arcade missions you took on as Trevor in GTA V would feel out of place in this world. Still, the changes and the way you approach gameplay go much deeper, and it's not always for the best, slowing the pace and leaning into a life simulator over the action-packed mayhem most expected.
Some aspects of GTA 6 feel unwarranted, like needing to lift weights. Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas featured a similar gameplay element, but it wasn't hailed as a highlight, and no one begged for it to come back. The game also tells you to eat or face consequences, which hinders gameplay. You could be about to kick in the door of a drug den to rob it blind , only to be told you're hungry and need to eat, so your health won't regenerate. If you're lucky, there may be a bag of chips to pick up and eat, but with cops potentially on the way, it cuts into your time.
Numerous missions pertain to doing chores. Whether it is fixing up the house or buying groceries, you will spend time doing the very tasks you sat down to escape. It's not lost on me that this endears the player to the characters and allows for an emotional bond, which is critical in the early stages of the story. Still, it can seriously hinder pacing and escapism. Plus, you are playing as a couple, so your actions can affect the relationship in positive and negative ways, which makes doing the menial tasks feel important when most would rather skip past them.
Grand Theft Auto VI Rockstar Players have grown pretty accustomed to using the GTA Weapons Wheel to navigate their personal inventory. It lets you carry an impossible number of guns, which you can tuck away at any time to hide. GTA 6 leans into the realistic RPG elements with its changes to the Weapons Wheel . You have what you own, with weapons stored in Ammu-Nation gun safes and personal vehicles, and clothes stored in closets, plus additional outfits you can place in your car.
When you're out and about in the massive open world, you have what you're carrying, and you can retrieve items from your personal vehicle. However, weapons such as rifles and shotguns remain visible, making you stand out like a sore thumb. You can drop the weapons or stash them in a vehicle, but you can't simply tuck them away into the depths of your Weapon Wheel. This adds realism to the story and the world it creates, but it also hinders a core GTA experience. I feel like this will need to change in some way for GTA 6 's online mode when it finally releases, but that remains to be seen.

articles.chapeau: Livin
articles.txt:
GTA 6 has been updated to support PS Plus Premium cloud streaming directly to the PS5 and PS Portal .
To be crystal clear about this: the game has not been added to the PS Plus Premium catalogue and you will still need to own it.
However, assuming you’ve purchased the game – and millions of you have – then you’ll now be able to stream it directly from Sony’s servers, assuming you’re a PS Plus Premium member.
There are a number of use cases for this, but the most likely is you’re away from your console and still want to play on your PS Portal. Now you won’t need to rely on Remote Play; you can just stream it directly.
This feature wasn’t available at launch, but I’ve been able to test it on my PS5 here in the UK and it’s working well.
There was some reporting prior to release that Microsoft had secured “ exclusive ” streaming rights to this title, but they were quickly clarified. This update now confirms boss Asha Sharma misspoke.

articles.t: As GTA 6 PC port gets closer to becoming playable, Rockstar is reportedly taking action against modders and Discord communities
articles.chapeau: After Cyberleek released the missing executable file for the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6, modders managed to boot the game on PC within a few hours. However, it seems Rockstar Games is now taking action against different modders and Discord communities.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek recently released the missing executable file for the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 , bringing modders a step closer to making the game playable on PC. In fact, within hours of its release, some modders managed to boot the game on PC and even get past the initial setup. However, it appears that Rockstar Games is now taking action against communities involved in these efforts.
One of the most notable projects working on bringing GTA 6 to PC was Leonida. Developed by ItsNotRexed, it was an open-source static recompilation project hosted on GitHub. Its main goal was to get the Xbox version of GTA 6 running natively on PC.
However, NotRexed has now announced that he is stepping away from the project, citing circumstances beyond his control. At the time of writing, the Leonida Project's GitHub page is no longer accessible, while its Discord server has also been taken down. His statement suggests that the project's removal may not have been his own decision, although the exact circumstances remain unclear.
Leonida isn't the only community to have disappeared. According to reports from users on Reddit, Rockstar Games is allegedly targeting several GTA 6 -related Discord servers, with users claiming that even a community with around six million members has been taken down.
Several other Discord servers associated with GTA 6 modding and unofficial PC port development have reportedly suffered a similar fate. However, Rockstar has yet to publicly comment on these reported takedowns.
Despite these developments, several other modders are still actively working on getting GTA 6 running on PC. It remains to be seen whether Rockstar will take similar action against the remaining projects and how much this will slow down their progress.

Cyberleek a publié une version presque complète de GTA 6 à la fin de la semaine dernière, ne retenant que l’exe principal – la partie qui fait fonctionner tout le reste, essentiellement – ​​jusqu’à ce que leur crypto-monnaie atteigne une capitalisation boursière de 15 millions de dollars, ou le 23 novembre, selon la première éventualité. La crypto a beaucoup manqué, mais le temps passe, et nous y voilà.
La sortie de l’exe inclut naturellement un appel à davantage de « dons » dans son fichier Lisez-moi (via Reddit) qui, selon Cyberleek, servira à un projet secret « pour les joueurs ». Ils ont également nargué les efforts de Take-Two Interactive pour les retrouver : « Des mois de retraits, d’assignations à comparaître et de recherche de portefeuilles plus tard, la chasse est toujours en cours et les téléchargements continuent d’arriver. Aucun budget ne rend un verrou incassable, et aucune ordonnance du tribunal ne supprime ce qu’Internet possède déjà. »
Les fuites dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo ne sont pas nouvelles, mais ce cas est unique : GTA 6, effectivement le plus grand jeu vidéo de tous les temps, n’a toujours pas été annoncé sur PC, comme c’est le cas de Take-Two. Mais l’avènement de l’IA signifie que le jeu pourrait être émulé sur notre plateforme beaucoup plus rapidement que cela n’était possible dans le passé – certains moddeurs estimaient que cela pourrait se produire d’ici une semaine.
L’un des responsables du projet de refonte de Leonida a prédit que les choses commenceraient à bouger rapidement à partir de là :
Dans le même temps, Shayder a tempéré les attentes dans un message sur Leonida Discord, affirmant « qu’il faudra au moins une semaine » pour que le projet atteigne le point où GTA sera jouable sur PC.
Comment cette version émulée non officielle faite avec l’IA se comparerait-elle à la vraie affaire est une question ouverte, et je soupçonne fortement que la réponse sera « pas bien », mais même le simple fait d’avoir quelque chose de GTA 6-ish jouable sur PC est un casse-tête que je suis presque sûr que Take-Two préférerait ne pas avoir à gérer. Je me demande également si cela incitera Take-Two à publier GTA 6 sur PC plus rapidement qu’avec les versions précédentes. Une rumeur à ce sujet a fait surface en octobre et j’avais de sérieux doutes, mais il est possible que les efforts d’émulation en cours accélèrent son arrivée.
Je n’ai pas vérifié si l’exe publié est légitime, mais le matériel publié précédemment semble l’être et le consensus général est que c’est également le cas. Et sur ce, je vous rappelle (oui, encore une fois) que le piratage de logiciels est illégal et que les fichiers louches provenant d’inconnus sur Internet peuvent contenir des logiciels malveillants.

articles.t: GTA 6 : une version PC non officielle déjà en préparation grâce à la build Xbox volée
articles.txt:
Quelques heures seulement après la diffusion de la build Xbox complète de GTA 6 par le groupe de hackers Cyberleek , la communauté des moddeurs a déjà réussi à créer une première version PC non officielle du jeu. Cette conversion, encore très limitée, permet d’accéder aux écrans de démarrage, aux réglages et aux informations légales, mais pas encore au gameplay. Cependant, les progrès pourraient s’accélérer dans les semaines à venir, grâce notamment à l’utilisation d’outils d’intelligence artificielle.
La build Xbox de GTA 6 a fuité il y a quelques heures à peine, et déjà, des moddeurs ont réussi à la faire fonctionner sur PC. Cette première version, qualifiée de « teaser » par la communauté, ne permet pas encore d’explorer le monde ouvert de Vice City, mais elle prouve que la conversion est techniquement possible. Les moddeurs ont utilisé des outils d’IA comme Claude pour analyser le code de la version Xbox et l’adapter à l’architecture PC. Une prouesse qui aurait été impensable il y a encore quelques années.
Pour l’instant, les joueurs curieux ne peuvent que naviguer dans les menus de configuration, choisir les commandes et consulter les mentions légales. Aucun élément de gameplay n’est accessible, mais les spécialistes estiment que cela pourrait changer rapidement. Les projets de reverse engineering de ce type ont déjà démontré leur capacité à évoluer vite, surtout lorsqu’ils s’appuient sur des modèles d’IA performants.
Le principe de ces conversions repose sur l’analyse du code original de la version console, ici la build Xbox, pour le rendre compatible avec les PC. L’intelligence artificielle joue un rôle clé dans ce processus : elle permet de comprendre le fonctionnement du code et de le réécrire pour une autre plateforme. Cette méthode, encore expérimentale, pourrait réduire considérablement le temps nécessaire pour obtenir une version jouable.
Les moddeurs à l’origine de ce projet n’ont pas encore communiqué de calendrier précis. La complexité technique de GTA 6 , avec ses nombreux systèmes de jeu et son monde ouvert très détaillé, rend difficile toute prédiction. Néanmoins, l’enthousiasme de la communauté est palpable, et certains espèrent voir des séquences de gameplay dans les prochaines semaines.
Cette fuite et la conversion PC qui en découle représentent un sérieux problème pour Rockstar Games . Le studio, connu pour son obsession de la sécurité, a déjà été victime de plusieurs violations majeures, dont le fameux leak de 2022 qui avait dévoilé des images du jeu en développement. Mais cette fois, la situation est différente : la build Xbox complète est entre les mains de la communauté, et une version PC non officielle pourrait voir le jour avant la sortie officielle du jeu sur cette plateforme.
Rockstar Games n’a pas encore officiellement annoncé de version PC pour GTA 6 , qui doit sortir en 2025 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Si une conversion non officielle devenait jouable, cela pourrait pousser le studio à accélérer ses plans, voire à revoir sa stratégie de sortie. Pour l’instant, Rockstar se concentre sur des actions légales contre les responsables de la fuite, mais la diffusion massive de la build rend la situation difficile à contrôler.
Pour les joueurs PC, cette nouvelle est à double tranchant. D’un côté, elle laisse entrevoir la possibilité de découvrir GTA 6 plus tôt que prévu, même si cela se ferait via une version non officielle et potentiellement instable. De l’autre, elle soulève des questions éthiques et légales : utiliser une build volée est illégal et expose à des risques de sécurité. De plus, une telle version ne bénéficierait d’aucun support officiel et pourrait être truffée de bugs.
Il est important de rappeler que le téléchargement et l’utilisation de cette build sont interdits et peuvent entraîner des poursuites. Rockstar Games a déjà engagé des actions en justice contre les personnes impliquées dans la fuite, et les autorités pourraient également sévir contre les utilisateurs. Les joueurs sont donc invités à la prudence et à attendre une éventuelle annonce officielle concernant la version PC de GTA 6 .
En attendant, la communauté des moddeurs continue de travailler sur cette conversion, et il faudra suivre de près l’évolution de ce projet dans les prochaines semaines. Une chose est sûre : GTA 6 n’a pas fini de faire parler de lui.

articles.txt:
Arion Kurtaj , l'ancien membre de Lapsus$ qui avait dérobé chez Rockstar environ 90 vidéos de développement de GTA 6 en septembre 2022, vient d'être condamné à sept ans de prison par la Woolwich Crown Court de Londres. Le jeune homme de 21 ans a quitté le tribunal libre le jour même, en raison du temps déjà passé en détention.
Pour fixer la peine, le juge Mark Turner a mis en balance la gravité des faits, son jeune âge et ses antécédents médicaux, dont son autisme, rapporte l'AFP. Depuis son arrestation, il a passé deux ans dans un hôpital sécurisé.
« Vous êtes de toute évidence un jeune homme très talentueux », lui a déclaré le magistrat, cité par l'agence britannique PA. Il l'a aussi exhorté à ne pas gâcher ces talents en passant le reste de sa vie à entrer et sortir de prison.
La peine couvre une série d'attaques menées entre août 2021 et septembre 2022, quand il avait 16 et 17 ans. Il avait plaidé coupable le 16 novembre , trois jours avant la sortie du jeu.
Sous le pseudonyme TeaPotUberHacker, il avait mis en ligne les vidéos de GTA 6 en menaçant de publier le code source du jeu. Une partie des faits a été commise alors qu'il était en liberté sous caution, logé dans un hôtel, avec un téléphone et un Amazon Fire Stick branché sur la télévision de sa chambre.
Les chefs retenus visent aussi l'opérateur BT/EE, la banque en ligne Revolut et Uber. Le parquet britannique chiffre les dégâts chez Uber à plus de 2,8 millions de dollars . S'y ajoute la détention d'un téléphone portable en prison, en mars 2026.
En 2023, jugé inapte à comparaître, il était passé devant un jury de Southwark Crown Court, qui avait seulement établi qu'il avait commis les faits. Un juge avait ensuite ordonné, en décembre, son internement en hôpital pour une durée indéterminée. Une nouvelle évaluation l'a déclaré apte à plaider en 2025, ce qui a permis au parquet de relancer les poursuites.
Les vidéos volées en 2022 montraient déjà Vice City et Lucia, plus d'un an avant la première bande-annonce officielle. Arion Kurtaj apprend sa peine alors que GTA 6 tourne sur des millions de consoles et a battu des records de ventes dès son lancement.
Dans l'enquête de Bloomberg sur la genèse du jeu , Aaron Garbut, l'un des dirigeants de Rockstar North, comparait la fuite à quelqu'un qui « fouillait dans votre linge sale ». Selon la même enquête, les équipes de GTA 6 n'ont pas accès aux serveurs du studio à distance.

CyberLeek, a hacking gang, released a 57MB archive Monday that it says completes a stolen Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6 and could help modders port the game to PC.
The group updated its website with a link to the archive. "The exe is out. Always free. An early Christmas gift from CL," CyberLeek wrote in a post titled "Xmas came early." The archive completes the stolen Xbox build that CyberLeek began circulating last week through a 209GB torrent containing files for Rockstar's RAGE game engine and the Xbox console.
CyberLeek says the file dump will let the modding community recompile the game for PC, because the Xbox platform runs on an operating system based on Microsoft Windows. "The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects," the gang wrote. The group asks for donations to its meme coin after earlier efforts to push that coin's market cap failed.
One recompilation project, Leonida, has examined the leaked executable files. Traffic overloaded the group's Discord chat server, which malfunctioned and appeared to crash. An admin posted after the outage: "It will take at least a week for us to get somewhere noticeable to the point where you can play on your pc." The admin added: "We will not be giving assets whatsoever; you will need to download the game yourself." Before the leak dropped, an admin posted: "This .exe file does NOT RUN THE GAME. This will be used by the developers to work with and make the actual recomp, which will use the game files and exe to build the port."
Users in the project have used AI coding tools and agents, including Anthropic's Claude, to reverse-engineer the leaked files and try to run them on Windows. One user in the Discord chat claimed: "THE GAME ALMOST BOOTS. BLACK SCREEN, AUDIO CUTS OFF."
Rockstar Games and its parent, Take-Two Interactive, have not responded to a request for comment. Rumors point to an official PC release for GTA 6 as soon as the first quarter of next year. A pirated PC port could go viral and sap sales for a game that remains exclusive to the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
The dumped files suggest CyberLeek infiltrated and stole an Xbox copy of GTA 6 before the game launched. Take-Two subpoenaed major platforms, including Microsoft, for records in an effort to find the leaker. CyberLeek remains at large.

Arion Kurtaj, le hacker responsable de la fuite de près d’une heure de séquences de développement de GTA 6 en 2022, a été libéré ce lundi 23 novembre en faisant l’objet d’une libération conditionnelle. Âgé de 21 ans, il a été condamné à sept ans de prison par le tribunal de Woolwich au Royaume-Uni, mais a pu sortir immédiatement après avoir déjà passé plusieurs années en détention et dans un établissement psychiatrique sécurisé.
Le jeune homme, membre du groupe de hackers Lapsus$, avait plaidé coupable le 16 novembre d’une série de cyberattaques visant plusieurs grandes entreprises, dont Rockstar Games, Uber, Revolut et l’opérateur BT/EE. Les faits remontent à ses 16 et 17 ans. Au total, il a reconnu six infractions, parmi lesquelles des accès informatiques non autorisés, une fraude et la possession d’un téléphone portable en prison. Sept autres accusations ont été conservées au dossier sans faire l’objet d’une condamnation.
L’intrusion la plus médiatisée remonte à septembre 2022 . Alors qu’il se trouvait dans un hôtel de Bicester en Angleterre, où il avait été placé sous protection policière après de précédentes affaires de piratage, Arion Kurtaj a réussi à pénétrer dans les systèmes internes de Rockstar Games. Son ordinateur ayant été confisqué, il a utilisé une clé Amazon Fire TV connectée au téléviseur de sa chambre, accompagnée d’un clavier et d’une souris Bluetooth, pour accéder au réseau informatique de l’établissement et mener son attaque.
Il a récupéré 90 vidéos montrant près de 60 minutes de séquences de développement de GTA 6 , encore loin de sa version finale. Après avoir tenté d’extorquer Rockstar Games en menaçant de publier le code source du jeu, il a diffusé les images sur des forums sous le pseudonyme TeaPotUberHacker. Cette fuite avait notamment révélé l’existence de Lucia, première protagoniste féminine de la série dans un rôle principal jouable. Rockstar Games avait estimé le coût de remise en état de ses systèmes à 5 millions de dollars, sans compter les milliers d’heures de travail mobilisées par ses équipes
L’affaire avait connu un premier dénouement judiciaire en décembre 2023. Après une expertise médicale, Arion Kurtaj avait été déclaré inapte à comparaître devant un tribunal en raison de son état de santé et de son autisme. Un juge avait alors ordonné son placement dans un établissement psychiatrique sécurisé pour une durée indéterminée avec des restrictions. Un jury avait néanmoins établi qu’il avait bien commis les piratages qui lui étaient reprochés.
En janvier 2026, une nouvelle évaluation a permis la levée de cette mesure et son transfert dans une prison classique, ouvrant la voie à un procès pénal. Après son plaidoyer de culpabilité du 16 novembre, la justice a prononcé une peine de sept ans, réduite de deux années pour tenir compte du temps passé sous hospitalisation sécurisée. Il a donc pu quitter sa détention dès le prononcé du jugement, sous le régime d’une libération conditionnelle.
Sa sortie s’accompagne de restrictions supplémentaires. Selon la BBC , une ordonnance de prévention des crimes graves (SCPO) lui interdit notamment d’utiliser Telegram et Discord pendant cinq ans. Le juge Justice Turner lui a adressé un avertissement lors de l’audience : « Vous êtes manifestement un jeune homme très talentueux. Ne laissez pas cela se reproduire ». La police de la Cité de Londres indique également vouloir obtenir une telle ordonnance, ce qui laisse une incertitude sur la formalisation définitive de ces restrictions.
Merci de nous avoir signalé l'erreur, nous allons corriger cela rapidement.

articles.t: Cyberleek Leaks GTA 6 EXE File, PC Port Efforts Begin

articles.txt:
Getting GTA 6 running on PC without waiting for Rockstar has become the latest goal for the modding community. Cyberleek has fulfilled its threat by releasing the missing 57MB main executable file (.exe) for the leaked Xbox development build . This follows its previous release of a massive 209GB torrent containing RAGE engine assets and Xbox build files.
Cyberleek described the release as an “early Christmas gift” and a protest against digital subscription models and expensive editions, including $20 “Ultimate Editions”. The group had previously linked the release to its cryptocurrency reaching a $15 million market value, but eventually made the file available on November 23 as promised.
The Xbox build was chosen because modern Xbox games use technology closely related to Windows, making it easier to bring them to PC. Projects such as Leonida are now working to recompile the game so it can run natively on PC.
Developers are already using AI coding tools such as Anthropic’s Claude to read the files and understand the game’s code. However, getting it to run remains a challenge. An update shared on the project’s Discord server stated : “THE GAME ALMOST BOOTS. BLACK SCREEN, AUDIO CUTS OFF.”
Although the game is getting closer to running, there is still a lot of work left. The project team says it could take at least another week of work before a playable PC version is ready.
Meanwhile, Cyberleek’s release has put Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar Games’ parent company, under further pressure. The company has reportedly been trying to remove the leaked files from the internet through takedowns and legal requests.
If the modding community manages to release a working PC version, Rockstar and its parent company could take further action.
For now, PC players will have to wait for Rockstar’s official release. While the modders are getting closer to making the leaked build run on PC, there’s still a lot of work ahead before anyone can actually play it. And if you come across a download claiming to offer a working PC version of GTA 6 , be careful, as these files are often fake and may contain viruses.
As more information becomes available, we’ll make sure to let you guys know here at eTeknix.
In other news, GTA 6 has reportedly reached 20 million pre-orders before launch , potentially generating over $1.6 billion in revenue. In addition, the game has broken Twitch’s all-time gaming viewership record , reaching 3.3 million concurrent viewers just hours after launch.

articles.t: GTA 6 leaker reportedly releases file needed to run leaked Xbox build

articles.txt:
GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek has reportedly released the executable file for the leaked Xbox build of the game, prompting concern that an unofficial PC port could follow.
The leak comes via the same group that shared leaked footage and threatened to release additional videos unless Rockstar changed its all-digital launch strategy a week before Rockstar released its extended gameplay teaser on Netflix . The group then threatened to release a full build of the game, including its full story mode and end credits.
Now, as reported by IGN , Cyberleek has released the .exe for the incomplete Xbox build, with some predicting that AI-assisted recompilation of the build could get GTA 6 running on PC within days.
The file was released alongside a new statement in which Cyberleek claimed their actions were about "fighting anti-consumerism in the games industry."
They also referenced Take-Two's efforts to stop the leaks and identify whoever is behind them, saying: "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving."
Cyberleek also pushed back on claims that the leaks are little more than a crypto scheme, insisting the crypto was used to raise money for a secret project unrelated to the game. "There is no other way to move funds without names," they said, "and this work requires no names."
According to IGN, the leaked Xbox build runs counter to the idea that Cyberleek only had access to an early build.
Take-Two previously issued subpoenas to companies including Discord as part of its search for those responsible for the leaks. It remains unclear how this build got out of Rockstar.

articles.t: One Step Closer to GTA 6 on PC: Cyberleek Releases Xbox Build Executable as Modders Work on a PC Port
articles.chapeau: The hacker or hacking group known as Cyberleek has released the executable file for the previously leaked decrypted Xbox version of GTA 6. Meanwhile, several projects are working to port Grand Theft Auto VI to PC or run it through emulation, VideoCardz reports.
articles.txt:
Andriy Rusanov Author of news articles for Mezha with four years of experience editing news feeds. I am a geek in everything I write about, but most of all in computers. 23 November, 21:41 0 The hacker or hacking group known as Cyberleek has released the executable file for the previously leaked decrypted Xbox version of GTA 6. Meanwhile, several projects are working to port Grand Theft Auto VI to PC or run it through emulation, VideoCardz reports .
On November 19, Cyberleek leaked 209 GB of decrypted GTA 6 assets for Xbox, with the executable notably absent. The archive containing the missing file is now circulating through several sources. The leaker also provided SHA-256 checksums for both the archive and the executable to protect users from malicious imitations .
The executable's release gives enthusiasts investigating the Xbox build more room to work. Microsoft's consoles use AMD's x86-64 architecture, while the Xbox development environment shares similarities with Windows. The leaked files could therefore help bring the game to PC.
Several projects, including ItsNotRexed's Leonida, are working on recompiling GTA 6 for Windows. The Leonida team has already extracted and translated all 26,503 RDNA2 shaders into Vulkan SPIR-V. Xbox2Windows explores recompiling Xbox software for Windows, while XCL converts Xbox GPU shaders into DirectX-compatible code. All three projects are available on GitHub. Xbox emulation projects also include ScarlettX, AnyXboxX, and Xbox Emulator.
As before, Cyberleek insists that the files are free of charge, although the leaker has once again tied their release to the market capitalization of his own cryptocurrency. The initial threshold of $15 million was reduced to $6 million.

articles.t: GTA 6 sur PC : Cyberleek partage l'exécutable, le portage Leonida progresse
articles.chapeau: Après avoir partagé l'intégralité de la version Xbox de Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), le groupe de hackers Cyberleek propose aujourd'hui l'ultime fichier :
articles.txt:
Sony détaille un peu plus la rétrocompatibilité sur sa PlayStation 5. Il sera possible de jouer à la grande majorité des jeux PlayStation 4 sur la PS5, mais tous ne seront pas compatibles.
Après avoir partagé l’intégralité de la version Xbox de Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ) , le groupe de hackers Cyberleek propose aujourd’hui l’ultime fichier : le fichier exécutable. Cela va permettre au projet Leonida de porter le jeu de manière officieuse sur PC.
Le fichier .exe est disponible. Toujours gratuit. Un cadeau de Noël avant l’heure de la part de CL. Le flambeau est désormais transmis aux projets open source de recompilation et d’émulation. Avant de faire confiance à un fichier, vérifiez-le. Voici les seuls et uniques hachages authentiques.
ZIP SHA-256 : 7545a2f7fb4b399cf8850987f087ed9a4d8499ddb6d6c2d642fd60c27f569730
EXE SHA-256 : e95020b2fa4a721db3df59fdecf75621730ac559d8835252f6c3b658d5a08993
Chaque version a toujours été gratuite et le restera. Si ce projet vous tient à cœur, soutenez-le. Chaque don est un vote en faveur de la poursuite de cette initiative. CL suit la direction indiquée par les votes. La cryptomonnaie n’est ici qu’un outil : il n’existe aucun autre moyen de transférer des fonds de manière anonyme. Vous trouverez l’histoire complète dans le fichier README.txt contenu dans l’archive ZIP. Pas de propriété du jeu, pas de paix.
Comme dit précédemment, il s’agit ici de la version Xbox et non de la version PC. Il ne suffit pas de télécharger le jeu et de lancer le fichier .exe pour jouer à GTA 6 sur PC. Tout un travail d’adaptation doit avoir lieu. Et il se trouve que c’est déjà en cours.
Le projet Leonida sur GitHub a pour but de recompiler la version Xbox de GTA 6 pour la faire tourner sur PC sans passer par un émulateur. Les développeurs du projet ne se cachent pas d’utiliser Claude, l’intelligence artificielle d’Anthropic, pour arriver au but qu’ils désirent. Ils ont déjà progressé comme ils le dévoilent sur leur Discord puisqu’ils ont été en mesure de lancer le jeu… mais tombent sur un écran noir. Ce n’est que le début, il reste encore énormément de travail. Mais il y a déjà eu beaucoup de progrès en coulisses ces derniers jours.
Il se trouve que les Xbox Series X/S et les PC utilisent la même architecture, à savoir des processeurs x86-64. Cela va donc faciliter la tâche. Malgré tout, le jeu de Rockstar Games se repose sur des éléments spécifiques aux consoles de Microsoft et les auteurs du projet Leonida vont donc devoir réussir à les adapter sur PC avec l’aide de Claude.
Pour rappel, Rockstar Games a annoncé que Grand Theft Auto VI a représenté 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes lors de sa première journée. Il y a eu 32,5 millions de précommandes.

articles.chapeau: Cyberleek publie l'exécutable Xbox de GTA 6. Project Leonida peut désormais avancer vers une recompilation PC, mais le jeu reste encore injouable.
articles.txt:
Après avoir diffusé une imposante archive de fichiers Xbox de GTA VI sans fournir le moyen de lancer le jeu, Cyberleek a finalement publié l’exécutable manquant ce 23 novembre. Une étape importante pour les développeurs amateurs qui tentent de faire fonctionner le titre de Rockstar sur PC grâce à la recompilation native ; mais malgré les premiers progrès annoncés, une version jouable reste encore à construire.
Pour rappel, Cyberleek avait mis en circulation le 19 novembre une archive d’environ 209 Go, présentée comme une version Xbox Series X|S du jeu, identifiée sous le numéro 1.0.2.1 et datée de novembre 2026. Elle contenait notamment des ressources graphiques, des textures, des modèles et des fichiers audio, mais pas l’exécutable principal indispensable au démarrage. Le leaker avait promis de publier ce dernier le 23 novembre, tout en conditionnant une éventuelle diffusion anticipée à la capitalisation de sa cryptomonnaie.
Cette fois, le fichier a bien été mis en ligne, accompagné de clés de contrôle SHA-256 censées permettre d’en vérifier l’intégrité ; son authenticité n’a toutefois pas encore été confirmée de manière indépendante. Cyberleek précise par ailleurs qu’il ne faut pas tenter de l’exécuter directement sous Windows : il est destiné aux équipes travaillant sur des outils de recompilation et d’émulation, ce qui nécessitera encore un peu de travail supplémentaires, mais rien d’insurmontable mais les moddeurs.
Parmi les initiatives concernées, Project Leonida cherche à transformer la version Xbox en une version PC native. La recompilation statique consiste à adapter le code du jeu et les composants propres à l’environnement Xbox pour qu’ils puissent fonctionner sous Windows. Le projet avait déjà préparé une partie importante du travail, notamment la traduction des shaders graphiques vers Vulkan.
La publication de l’exécutable a rapidement permis de progresser : quelques heures après sa diffusion, les développeurs de Leonida indiquaient que le jeu approchait du démarrage, malgré un écran noir et des coupures audio. Ce résultat reste très éloigné d’une version pleinement fonctionnelle, mais marque un premier pas concret.
Cyberleek avait assuré que la communauté pourrait faire tourner le jeu à plus de 30 images par seconde en une semaine, au grand dam de la philosophie de Rockstar . Cette prédiction reste à prendre avec prudence : démarrer le jeu ne signifie pas pouvoir y jouer dans de bonnes conditions. Rockstar, de son côté, n’a toujours pas annoncé de date pour une éventuelle version PC officielle.

articles.t: GTA 6 Xbox Executable Leaks Online as “Early Christmas Gift” from Cyberleek
articles.chapeau: Just days after release, a playable build leaks.
articles.txt:
By Kyle Gratton Published Nov 23, 2026, 1:38 PM EST Kyle Gratton is an writer and editor based out of Kansas City. He received a bachelor's degree, dual majoring in English and History with a minor in Film and Media Studies, and has been a senior writer and gaming critic for Screen Rant since 2021 and CBR since 2026, in addition to a role in editorial. A terminal Midwesterner who graduated from the University of Kansas, Kyle also has knowledge and interest in literature, film, film adaptions of literature, and history. Find Kyle on Letterboxd: KyleG5 Sign in to your CBR account The executable file for Grand Theft Auto 6 's Xbox version has been released by notorious hacker(s) Cyberleek, meaning it may only be a matter of time before a PC recompilation is built. Rockstar Games' latest open-world crime odyssey has seen unprecedented popularity, becoming the highest-grossing entertainment product of all time, despite a review bombing campaign by disgruntled manosphere types. GTA 6 has, notably, only released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, with a potential PC port yet to be confirmed by Rockstar.
Development of Grand Theft Auto 6 was plagued for years by leaks. A massive haul of mid-development GTA 6 gameplay footage leaked in 2022, an unprecedented breach that would only be topped by a leaker (or leakers) known as Cyberleek posting release-build footage online just months before the game's launch. Cyberleek has now made good on a promise to release the build they acquired for their previous leaks.
Jason and Lucia dancing together in GTA 6 Image via Rockstar Games The executable (.exe) file for GTA 6 's Xbox version 1.0.2.1 is now available on Cyberleek's website. This is a release version of GTA 6 , only playable on an Xbox Series X or Series S, and not an available PC version. It is available as a torrent for free, but Cyberleek is still asking for donations to fund a still-mysterious "project." They are alternatively still running their own cryptocurrency as a part of their fundraising.
CBR will not link directly to Cyberleek's website or the .exe file. Readers are urged to be extremely cautious of malware should they attempt to seek it out.
The readme.txt that accompanies the .exe has been copied to Pastebin , providing an overview of Cyberleek's stated motives, their project, which "stays under wraps for now," and various information about donating or trading the Cyberleek token. "Take the Xbox build and the main executable as an early Christmas gift," the readme file says, "from CYBERLEEK to every gamer."
Cyberleek's generous tone follows from the consumerist statements that begin the readme file. The hacker(s) reiterate their support of players, noting their leaks never contained story content because they didn't want to spoil the game that "Millions waited years for." This latest creed stresses that the leaks are targeted at corporations, and are not anti- GTA 6 : "The enemy is the tactic, not the game: subscriptions bolted onto single-player games, 20 dollar 'ultimate editions' that unlock what already sits in the game files, licenses sold as purchases. All of it needs to be eliminated."
GTA 6 key art featuring Radio La Ola Image via Rockstar Games This leak ultimately does little more than fast-track an unofficial PC port of GTA 6 . With the full Xbox build and the .exe file, recompilation efforts should, theoretically, have few barriers left. Vibe-coded attempts are almost certainly going to appear in the next few days, but it remains to be seen how well these bootleg versions run. Cyberleek seems confident that the leaked Xbox build will be emulated within a week's time.
If this version fails to get a working PC port of GTA 6 , Cyberleek will turn its attention to leaking the PS5 version. Cyberleek has so far been able to evade capture, ignoring "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing." Previous leaks were clearly not taken lightly, but a full build leaking is likely to spur Rockstar's efforts. Although piracy is broadly undertaken by only a small fraction of PC players, the threat of a recompilation could seriously jeopardize Rockstar's plans to bring Grand Theft Auto 6 to PC at a future date.
